name: @archcode/core
description: ArchCode core library: parse, validate, analyze, layout, and render architecture-as-code YAML.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:js && pnpm run build:types && pnpm run build:schema && pnpm run build:license && pnpm run build:package
scripts.build:js: esbuild src/index.ts src/constants.ts src/render/theme.ts src/tokens.ts src/canvas.ts --bundle --platform=neutral --format=esm --target=es2022 --packages=external --outdir=dist --outbase=src
scripts.test: vitest run --exclude test/perf.test.ts && vitest run test/perf.test.ts
